title: Demand Response Programs — Availability by Customer Class, Rate Schedule and Meter
content:
## Availability

Each of Lakeshore Power & Light's Demand Response Programs is available only to the customer class and on the rate schedules listed for it below. Where a communicating meter is required, a communicating interval meter must be in service at the address of the service agreement. Where life-support registrations are excluded, a service agreement with an active life-support registration may not hold that program.

| Program | Customer class eligible | Rate schedules on which the program may be held | Communicating interval meter required at the address | Agreements with an active life-support registration excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes | No |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes | Yes |
| AC Cycling Program | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes | Yes |
| Home Battery Dispatch | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes | No |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | Business | Schedules GS, GST and GD | Yes | No |
| Base Interruptible Program | Business | Schedules GD and LP | Yes | No |

Smart Thermostat Rewards and the AC Cycling Program are offered for homes with central air conditioning.

## Reading the table

- **Residential programs.** The four residential programs share one schedule list: Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service and Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service.
- **Business programs.** The Commercial Capacity Bidding Program is held on Schedule GS Small General Service, Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service or Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service. The Base Interruptible Program is held on Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service or Schedule LP Large Power Service. Schedule GD is the only schedule that appears in both business lists.
- **Meter.** Every program requires a communicating interval meter in service at the address.
- **Life support.** Only the two residential programs that control household air conditioning — Smart Thermostat Rewards and the AC Cycling Program — exclude agreements with an active life-support registration.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

| Hypothetical agreement | Program asked about | Class and schedule within the table? |
|---|---|---|
| Residential, Schedule REV | Home Battery Dispatch | Yes |
| Business, Schedule LP | Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | No — Schedule LP is not listed for that program |
| Business, Schedule GD | Base Interruptible Program | Yes |
| Business, Schedule GS | Base Interruptible Program | No — only Schedules GD and LP are listed |
| Residential, Schedule RT | Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | No — the program is for business customers |
